text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(There might be tons of Umamusume<n>out there who
are stronger than me...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(And there might be tons of<n>Umamusume whose
running is even<n>more eye-catching than mine...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (I know that nobody's morepassionate about running than I am!Because...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I love running! I really love it! I love itmore than the whole world!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And a Japanese runner has seized<n>victory here in
this international battle!<n>It's Ines Fujin! A flawless
win!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Ahaha! C'mon everyone,<n>you're going
overboard here... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, everyone, did your dreams<n>come true today?
As for me...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I feel like all my dreams just came<n>true at once!
